extension.name: System - AI Markdown for Gridbox
extension.author: Merserwis
extension.license: GNU Affero General Public License version 3 or later (AGPL-3.0-or-later)
extension.description: Native Markdown plugin for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.5 with llmstxt.org generator, B2B Price Anchoring, caching, YAML Frontmatter, hybrid FAQ, and AI analytics.

field.name: extension_info
field.label: Project & Support
field.description:
Repository & Docs: https://github.com/merserwis/plg_system_aimarkdown/

Contact: a.blazewicz@merserwis.pl | License: AGPL-3.0

field.name: enable_frontmatter
field.label: Enable YAML Frontmatter
field.description: Prepend structured YAML metadata (title, price, B2B net/gross, SKU, availability, category, downloads, seller) at the top of the Markdown for LLMs.

field.name: enable_faq
field.label: Enable Product FAQ Section
field.description: Include structured FAQ in Markdown. Prioritizes custom FAQPage Schema/details from description; auto-generates contextual Q&A if missing.

field.name: auto_generate_faq
field.label: Auto-generate Missing FAQs
field.description: If a product lacks a custom FAQ section, automatically generate smart Q&A (warranty, calibration, delivery, applications).

field.name: prioritize_pdfs
field.label: Prioritize PDF Downloads
field.description: Extract all PDF links (datasheets, manuals, catalogs), convert them to absolute URLs, and list them under a dedicated 'Downloads & Documentation' section.

field.name: unroll_tabs_accordions
field.label: Extract Tabs & Accordions
field.description: Unroll hidden tabs and collapsed accordions into clean sequential Markdown headings and sections for AI agents.

field.name: enable_cache
field.label: Enable Markdown Cache
field.description: Store converted Markdown files in cache to serve AI agents in milliseconds and reduce server load.

field.name: cache_time
field.label: Cache Lifetime
field.description: How long cached Markdown files should remain valid before regenerating.

field.name: custom_exclude_selectors
field.label: Custom Exclude Selectors
field.description: Enter one selector per line to strip matching elements from Markdown. Supported formats: • CSS Class: .promo-banner, .newsletter-popup • CSS ID: #live-chat, #cookie-bar • HTML Tag: aside, dialog • Tag with Class: div.popup, section.advert • XPath: //div[@data-banner='true']

field.name: show_category
field.label: Show Category
field.description: Display the post or product category in the generated Markdown.

field.name: show_tags
field.label: Show Tags
field.description: Display tags in the generated Markdown.

field.name: show_author
field.label: Show Author
field.description: Display the author in the generated Markdown.

field.name: show_date
field.label: Show Date
field.description: Display the publication date in the generated Markdown.

field.name: show_description
field.label: Show Description
field.description: Display the main post or product description in the generated Markdown.

field.name: show_images
field.label: Show Images
field.description: Include images in the generated Markdown.

field.name: show_custom_fields
field.label: Show Custom Fields
field.description: Display custom fields and product technical specifications from Balbooa Gridbox.

field.name: show_alternate_link
field.label: Show Alternate Link
field.description: Add the RFC 8288 Link header and the rel=alternate link tag in the HTML head section.

field.name: service_doc_path
field.label: Service Documentation Path
field.description: Path (relative to the site root) announced in the Link header as rel="service-doc", e.g. your contact or 'about' page. Leave empty to omit. Previous versions always announced /kontakt.

field.name: enable_llmstxt
field.label: Enable /llms.txt Generator
field.description: Automatically generates and maintains a standardized /llms.txt file in the site root directory according to https://llmstxt.org.

field.name: llms_site_title
field.label: Site / Project Title (H1)
field.description: The main title displayed at the top of /llms.txt. Empty = the Site Name from Global Configuration.

field.name: llms_site_summary
field.label: Short Summary Blockquote (>)
field.description: A concise 2-3 sentence overview of the company, accreditation, and offering for LLMs.
field.hint: e.g. Official distributor of testing equipment in Poland. Electrical safety meters, EVSE testing, power quality analyzers, and calibration services.

field.name: llms_auto_interval
field.label: Auto-generation Interval
field.description: Time interval between automated background regenerations of the /llms.txt file.

field.name: llms_exclude_urls
field.label: Exclude URLs from /llms.txt
field.description: Enter URLs or paths to exclude from /llms.txt, one per line (e.g. /koszyk, /polityka-prywatnosci, /logowanie).

field.name: llms_sort_by
field.label: Sort Items By
field.description: Choose how products and articles are prioritized in /llms.txt. Highly recommended: Most Popular (Hits).

field.name: llms_max_items
field.label: Max Products / Pages in /llms.txt
field.description: Limit items to prevent exceeding LLM context window limits. 500-1000 is recommended by llmstxt.org.
field.option: All Items (No Limit - May create very large file)

field.name: llms_menutype
field.label: Menu for 'Main sections'
field.description: Site menu whose public top-level items are listed in the 'Main sections' block. Default: main (as in previous versions).

field.name: llms_gridbox_url_mode
field.label: Gridbox URL Mode
field.description: How Gridbox page/category URLs are built. 'Alias' = root + alias (behaviour of previous versions). 'Joomla Router' = real SEF URLs generated by Joomla/Gridbox router (recommended when pages live under app/category paths).

field.name: enable_merchant_context
field.label: Enable Merchant Authority & CTA
field.description: Inject custom distributor credentials, E-E-A-T trust signals, and direct purchase instructions into Markdown for AI engines.

field.name: merchant_info_legend
field.label: How this helps your AI Rankings (GEO) & Available Tags
field.description:
Why is this crucial for AI? LLMs (SearchGPT, Perplexity, Claude) prefer recommending merchants who explicitly declare distributor status, local warranty, fast delivery, and calibration services rather than generic manufacturer pages.
Dynamic Tags Legend (Automatically replaced):
  • {title} - Product / Article Title
  • {sku} - Catalog Code / SKU Number
  • {price} - Formatted Price with Net/Gross & VAT
  • {price_net} - Net Price only
  • {price_gross} - Gross Price only
  • {currency} - Currency (e.g. PLN, EUR)
  • {availability} - Stock Status (e.g. InStock)
  • {brand} - Manufacturer / Brand Name
  • {category} - Product Category
  • {url} - Full Absolute Canonical URL

field.name: merchant_name
field.label: Merchant / Company Name
field.description: Injected into YAML Frontmatter ('seller') and used for authority citations.
field.hint: e.g. Merserwis or your company name

field.name: merchant_type
field.label: Business Role / E-E-A-T Title
field.description: Role or accreditation title (e.g. Official Polish Distributor, Accredited Calibration Laboratory).
field.hint: e.g. Official Polish Distributor & Accredited Laboratory

field.name: vat_rate
field.label: VAT Rate (%)
field.description: VAT rate used to derive net/gross prices when only one of them is shown on the page.

field.name: merchant_header_text
field.label: Header Authority Note (Above Content)
field.description: Text placed immediately after Frontmatter. Automatically formatted as a highlighted callout blockquote (>), no need to write '>' manually.
field.hint: **Oficjalna dystrybucja i serwis w Polsce:** Urządzenie {title} (kod: {sku}) dostępne bezpośrednio w ofercie oficjalnego dystrybutora z polską gwarancją i opcją wzorcowania.

field.name: merchant_footer_text
field.label: Footer CTA & Ordering Info (Below Content)
field.description: Markdown text appended at the very end of the content. Ideal for order instructions, delivery times, and direct contact numbers.
field.hint: ### Zamówienia i doradztwo techniczne * **Dystrybutor:** Nazwa Twojej Firmy * **Produkt:** {title} (SKU: {sku}) * **Cena:** {price} * **Dostępność i zamówienia:** [Zamów ten model online]({url}) * **Czas dostawy:** Wysyłka z magazynu w 24-48h. * **Kontakt handlowy:** Zadzwoń: +48 ... | E-mail: ...

field.name: enable_analytics
field.label: Enable AI Analytics
field.description: Log visits from AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Perplexity) locally in your database.

field.name: analytics_display_limit
field.label: Analytics Display Limit
field.description: Select how many top bots, top visited pages, and recent requests to display in the dashboard.

field.name: log_retention_days
field.label: Log Retention
field.description: Automatically purge logs older than specified number of days.

field.name: trust_proxy_headers
field.label: Trust Proxy IP Headers
field.description: Read the visitor IP from CF-Connecting-IP / X-Forwarded-For. Enable ONLY when the site is behind Cloudflare or your own reverse proxy - otherwise any client can forge these headers. When disabled, REMOTE_ADDR is used.
